status: alternative 3 selected by user; portrait integrated as first opponent
personality: More confident in his intuition than his understanding of the game
Curious, easily distracted by a clever-looking idea
A good sport who learns from mistakes
designIntent: A welcoming rival the player feels able to beat. His inexperience belongs to this individual beginner; it is not a cultural gag.

visual.hair: Thinning dark hair awkwardly combed across the crown
visual.face: Pear-shaped face, long nose, uneven eyes, crooked oval wire spectacles and sparse moustache
visual.wardrobe: Washed-out mustard T-shirt with a plain pocket
visual.readability: Consistent face and chin scale; restrained expressions; clean pixel clusters

tutorialRole.strength: Willing to experiment and commit to a plan
tutorialRole.mistake: Confuses adding more movement with reaching the survival region
tutorialRole.lesson: The player can recognize and improve on a clear strategic mistake
tutorialRole.fairness: Same physics and available card rules as the player; no hidden speed penalty or fabricated losses

expressions: Relaxed, mildly puzzled smile (selected static portrait)

fr.intro: J’ai compris. Il faut qu’ils survivent. Pour le reste, on va voir.
fr.plan: J’ai mis de la poussée. Au moins, ils vont quelque part.
fr.doubt: Ah. Ils peuvent tous se tromper de direction en même temps.
fr.defeat: OK, j’ai compris un truc. On en refait une ?

en.intro: I get it. They need to survive. The rest, we’ll figure out.
en.plan: I gave them some thrust. At least they’re going somewhere.
en.doubt: Oh. They can all go the wrong way at once.
en.defeat: Okay, I learned something. Another round?

integration: Selected portrait, localized name and origin displayed in the first opponent identity panel. Gameplay and proposed dialogue remain unchanged.
